title: Wherever You Go, There You Are

questions.q: What term does Jon Kabat-Zinn use for focusing on one activity at a time?
questions.why: He calls it practicing voluntary simplicity, meaning engage with one activity or thought at a time.

questions.q: According to the book, what is the primary benefit of choosing patience over anger?
questions.why: Patience is described as better for health, environment, and sanity.

questions.q: What simple practice does the author recommend for automatic behaviors?
a: Focus on your senses and body while doing them
Do them faster to finish quickly
questions.why: The smallest step suggested is to focus on senses and body during auto‑pilot actions.

questions.q: How does the author define mindfulness in relation to science?
a: Using science to prove mindfulness false
questions.why: Kabat‑Zinn's mission is to connect mindfulness with science.

questions.q: What does the author suggest you do when a phone notification interrupts a game with your child?
a: Apologize and set the phone aside
questions.why: The example advises saying sorry and putting the phone away rather than scrambling for it.
